summary: A team standup tracker: teammates post a short update via an API, and the whole team sees the running list.
requirements: Users can post a standup update (name + message) that is saved server-side.
Users can see the list of everyone's posted updates, newest first.
Updates persist across page reloads and are shared across every client, not just the browser that posted them.
acceptanceCriteria: Posting an update saves it via a server API and it appears in the list without a manual refresh.
Reloading the page still shows previously posted updates (server-side persistence, not per-browser storage).
The app renders without a runtime crash in preview.
nonGoals: No authentication or per-user accounts for this pass.
testChecklist: Open the app and confirm the update form and list render.
Post an update and confirm it appears at the top of the list.
Confirm the update was persisted via the API, not just local component state.
stackProfileReasoning: Updates must be shared across every teammate's client, not just the posting browser, so persistence has to live behind a real server API rather than browser-only PGlite.
designLanguageReasoning: A running feed of short status updates from a team is exactly the compact, scannable, data-first layout dense-dashboard is built for.
